items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I just used tenor, trumpet, piano, drums and bass... Par Jones used to put that harmon mute in there... And Par Jones.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was kind of a character. And he worked with me at the Downbeat, too. Because, you know, I remember that he worked with me about 2 or 3 different places, but after we went to the -- had a real great trumpet player at The Oasis; his name was Par Jones. I don't know, did you know Par Jones?
